title: GAP Waiver Plus 150 Exclusions: Number of Deferred Installments Counted
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Plus 150 excluded total: the deferral count.** The deferral part counts the deferred installments according to the installments deferred by every extension the Retail Installment Contracts contract records. These are the installments of all those extensions taken together.

**Rule.**

- One in total: none is counted.
- Exactly two: one is counted.
- Otherwise: all are counted.

*Boundary cases.*

- Two deferred installments in total give a count of one.
- Three give a count of three.
- One gives none.
